marc:datafield.marc:subfield: அழகின் அசைவு : பண்பாட்டுக் கட்டுரைகளின் முழுத் தொகுப்பு | azakin acaivu Panpaattu Katturaikalin Muzhu Thokuppu

"Alagin Asaivu" explores Tamil literature and culture, tracing its evolution from ancient texts like Purananuru to modern poetry, and from classical grammar to contemporary spoken Tamil. The book highlights the history of marginalized communities, religious practices, cultural festivals, traditional foods, clothing, and games. It reveals social hierarchies, historical continuities, and everyday cultural practices, offering a comprehensive and engaging look at the rich tapestry of Tamil heritage. This collection of essays provides valuable insights for scholars, researchers, and general readers alike, celebrating the diverse and intricate aspects of Tamil culture.
